Cass (Design): Quick callout 0: in the stacktrace flyout we show a small correlation pill with an inline copy icon and an Export button. Keyboard flow currently tabs Export -> Copy -> Close which feels off. Thoughts on reorder + SR labels?

Ivy (Product): Support asked for Copy to be very visible. But if keyboard users get a weird order we should fix it. Is the underlying DOM order different from visual?

Rafael (Eng-Frontend): Yeah DOM order was [Export][Copy][Close] while visually Close is in the middle. I'll reorder DOM to match visual: Export -> Close -> Copy. Also found the copy icon has no `aria-label` (relying on tooltip). Will add `aria-label="Copy correlation ID"`.

Anika (Accessibility): Nice. Also: when copy happens, announce via a polite live region but keep it generic: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard." Don't read the full ID. For Export, use a `role="status"` message like "Trace bundle download started." Also ensure export button contrast meets 4.5:1; current orange token fails on white.

Dion (Eng-UX): For small screens let's collapse Copy into the kebab menu so primary action remains Download. On desktop keep Copy visible but adjacent to Close. UX wise that groups session actions together.

Cass (Design): Microcopy change proposal: primary CTA = "Download trace bundle" and menu item = "Export raw JSON". Helper line: "Bundle includes spans, logs, and attachments." Also prefer explicit labels on icons.

Ivy (Product): Agreed. Analytics note: keep `trace_export.clicked` stable, add `variant: bundle|json`. For copy use `trace_copy.clicked` with `target: correlation_id`. Don't rename existing events.

Rafael (Eng-Frontend): Implementation plan: 1) reorder DOM to match visual 2) remove stray `tabindex="-1"` 3) add `aria-label`s 4) implement small `div role="status" aria-atomic="true"` live region for messages 5) bump export color to `#b33b35` to pass contrast. I'll open a small PR with before/after screenshots and an 8s keyboard-only gif.

Anika (Accessibility): PR checklist for me: aria-labels, live region with generic messages, contrast screenshots, keyboard interaction video, and menu uses `aria-haspopup="true"` with roving tabindex. I'll review once PR is up.

Dion (Eng-UX): I'll update the design spec and add a short note about where Copy lives at different breakpoints. Cass will push the microcopy changes.

deploy-bot: Heads up 0: minor UI deploy window 04:00-04:30 UTC tomorrow; low risk.

Ivy (Product): Thanks all. If PR looks small we can ship in the next minor release. After deploy we'll run a quick internal a11y check and a 2-person hallway test. Ping me for blockers.

Cass (Design): I'll drop the copy snippets in the PR. Cheers everyone!
